title: Larry and Ron Tototz in their quarters
description: Larry (left) and his bunk mate Ron Tototz (right) inside their quarters — woven-matting walls, a shelf of personal items, a footlocker between them. Taken moments apart from VN-0002, in the same sitting.
researchNotes: Identified by Larry's son (giscus comment, 2026-08-13, discussion #30): 'Left: Larry Hunnewell / Right: Ron Tototz' — confirming the pair matches VN-0002, where Larry identified the same two men himself ('Left is me / Right: Ron Tototz'). On 2026-08-15 Larry confirmed it directly: 'Yes, me on the left and Ron on the right' (archived as data/recollections/giscus-vn-0001-c18032245.json).
